notes.title: [LPDF v0.2.0] Multiplayer and game mode implementation RELEASE
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha 0.2.0 Patch note coming in July 2022[/h1]

[h2]1. Multiplayer implementation
[/h2]
At the release of this patch, you will be able to play in 1vs1 and 2vs2 in P2P multiplayer featuring 2 game modes :

1vs1 and 2vs2 with normal sized unit
1vs1 with x2 soldiers per unit and per player.


[h2]2. UI improvement[/h2]

You can activate several option allowing you to get a better understanding of the gameplay :

Marker under your units feet
Over effect on your opponent troops
Pop-up of damage inflicted / taken as the player
Your name and name of the opponents player
Variety of bugfixes around UI


[h2]3. Gameplay improvement[/h2]

Implementation of victory condition to push the player to fight in a certain area (time limit, capture the flag, death count)
As you die, you become a gosth but can still manage your troops (only in multiplayer)
Improved animation behavior of both player and unit to smooth player vs IA interaction
Spell now override normal animation so they are always casted instantly
Implementation of many missings units and hero abilities in the skill trees
Some slight IA improvement but we will try to fix the IA saturation when several soldiers try to reach the same target
Gameplay will be overhauled later to make it more slower in multiplayer particulary in player vs player gameplay


[h2]4. Overall improvement[/h2]

Greatly improved sounds
Now units play a battle sounds when many agents are involved
All sergents now have unique voice line
Sounds are now played correctly when you are using spell or your weapon
Added sounds linked to units (charge yelling for exemple)
Lot of little bugfixes and correction

notes.title: Alpha Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce our first patch for "[b]La Porte des fauconniers[/b]".

[u]It contains the following changes :[/u]

- First iteration of the taunt system for inactive melee units. As always, it is in WIP and it will be improved gradually

- Improved descriptions of sergeants, horn players and banner holders

- Fixed an issue with updating the units UI

- Fixed an issue with Agents regaining too much health, which improperly increased their ability to take hits

- Adjusted the stats of the hero's equipment

- Slight softening of melee mechanics to favor 3rd party units 2

We are waiting for your feedback on our steam discussion hub,

Thank you.

notes.title: Unit melee improvement
notes.content:
Hello everybody, 

Thank you for supporting us in this adventure ! 

We are currently working on improving the melees in "La Porte des fauconniers".

For now, AIs behave fairly basic, but very soon we will be implementing changes that will make the melee more airy. We are also going to implement the first iteration of the variation of the animations of the waiting postures in combat.

With this patch, the agents of a unit which are on the back line, instead of pushing their comrades at all costs to try to reach the adversaries, will play various animations to increase the immersion. It should also significantly reduce the build-up effect of overcrowded agents.

We are also going to fix some bugs on formation management to prevent units in shield wall from looking in the wrong direction.

We are also informed that many of you cannot complete the first card of the game (which unlocks the others). We are going to apply some balancing measures to help you in your progress in the game by significantly increasing the XP gain of your units for now, which will make your units much stronger faster.

We are curious to know if any of you have already managed to complete all the maps! Remember to share your exploits on our steam forum, we will come and offer you steam keys for your friends to reward your bravery !

Do not hesitate to visit the game's steam forum to report any problem to us! And we are also waiting for your suggestions, the game is still in its infancy, any good idea can be added to the project in addition to those already planned :)

Thank you !

notes.title: Road Map Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello Falconers ! [/b]

As we approach the implementation of our alpha 0.1.0 (solo) we wanted to take the opportunity to tell you about the development path that we are going to put in place for the end of the year 2021 and the year to come !

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/DbGxmK8RM2qpQ5q9Kx/giphy.gif[/img]

In our ALPHA 0.1.0 you will be able to begin to discover the mechanics that we wish to set up in "La porte des Fauconniers". [u]Keep in mind that this is only the beginning of the adventure and that the game will evolve quickly over time, so don't panic if things don't appeal to you ![/u]

[b]GOAL FOR END OF 2021 :[/b] 

[u]1) Implementing cavalery [/u]

Our main objective once the alpha is in line will be to set up the cavalry.

We will thus have set up all the basic mechanics of all the units in the game. From there, we can start improving them, making them more functional and debugging them.

It is also important for us to implement the cavalry from the start so that we can implement the complete AI overhaul.

[u]2) AI Overhaul [/u]

We have deliberately set up a very basic AI to save time in the pre-alpha phase. We didn't want to bother making too complex AI when we lacked archers and cavalry.

Once the horses are in place, we will have an overview of what our AI should do and it will be much simpler and more concrete.

[u]3) 600 units on screen[/u] 

The next step for us will be to succeed in displaying 600 agents on the screen simultaneously.

The goal is to pave the way for us to set up 3vs3 in multiplayer since if each of you comes with your 3 units, you will actually be around 600 on the battlefield.

We think about optimization in terms of target material.
For us, it's imperative that the game runs well on a high-end 2017 setup. So we want those 600 agents to perform well on a 1080 and an I5-4500.

For the others, it will be necessary to lower the graphics until we improve in the field.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kJAFGXVqjka1nJRplN/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]2022 STEP BY STEP :[/b]

[u]January 2022 :[/u]
[i]Mainly a stabilisation phase for us :[/i]
- Optimisation, 
- Bugfixes, 
- Skill trees improvement.

[u]February 2022 :[/u]
[i]We attack the hardest ![/i]
- First iteration of the multiplayer game mode 1vs1 
- We increase the number of players to reach 3vs3
- Unit personnalisation 

[u]March 2022 :[/u]
[i]From here, everything will depend on our performance on the multi[/i]
- If 3vs3 multi game mode is working fine, we will start to implement siege battles and artillery.
- If we struggle too much, we continue on the multi and we postpone this phase to the next month.

[u]May 2022 :[/u]
[i]From here the development can take two branches.[/i]

1) If we have a little success and a stable community, we will start to explore the feasibility of the multiplayer campaign.

2) If that's not the case or we're a little behind, we stick to the plan and make sure the multiplayer battle mode is running smoothly.

[i]Above all, keep in mind that there are only 3 of us ! On top of that, as French people we spend a lot of time arguing and sometimes it slows us down ! May the holy Baguette guide us towards the success of our goals!

We are counting on your support, bear with us![/i]

Thank your for reading !
